title: Amtrak named-asset reliability receives a role-separated verification-key registry
summary: A contract-specific registry identifies staged, active, rotated, expired, and revoked keys; permits exactly one active key; binds that key to the current release index; and separates signing, custody, release authorization, and incident command. Denominator: One contract-specific key-registry schema, twenty adversarial cases, six bounded valid routes, fourteen explicit rejections, and zero production keys activated or signatures issued.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Governed verification-key registry controls.
